DEPARTMENT OF FORESTS AND WILDLIFE
NOTIFICATION
Delhi, the 29th April, 2026
F. No. 32928/WFD/COT /2025-26/1303.–– WHEREAS, an application ID No. 32928 on DPTA e-Forest
portal was received by the Tree Officer (West Forest Division) from Sh. Rajesh Kumar Chief Manager, 400 /200KV
GIS Sub-station, sector-05, Dwarka, New Delhi-110075, for seeking permission under the Delhi Preservation of Trees
Act, 1994 (Delhi Act 11 of 1994) (hereinafter referred to as DPTA, 1994) for transplantation/felling of 40 (revised from
49) number of trees for Construction of Jhatikara- Dwarka 400 KV D/C line (Twin HTLS) under Rajasthan REZ
Phase-III, Part-D, phase-II Scheme, New Delhi, under Delhi Preservation of Trees Act (DPTA), 1994 in an area of
54.30 Ha.
AND WHEREAS, the Tree Officer (West Forest Division) after due application of mind, has sought
exemption in respect of 54.30 Ha. area (as per details in Annexure - A) under Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994 from
applicability of Section 9 sub-section (3) of the DPTA, 1994, in view of limitation of maximum one hectare area for
considering application of tree transplantation / felling by the Tree Officer (West Forest Division) in Section 9
sub-section (3) of the DPTA, 1994.
THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994, the Lt. Governor of
National Capital Territory of Delhi, hereby, in public interest, exempts an area of 54.30 Ha. (as per details in
Annexure - A), from the limitation of maximum one hectare area under sub-section (3) of Section 9 of the said Act for
construction of Jhatikara- Dwarka 400KV D/C line (Twin HTLS) under Rajasthan REZ Phase-III, part-D, phase-II
Scheme, New Delhi, under Delhi Preservation of Trees Act (DPTA), 1994 with the following conditions:
1) This notification is being issued under Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994 only to exempt the 54.30 Ha. area (as per
details in Annexure - A) from the limitation of maximum one hectare area under sub-section (3) of Section 9 of
the DPTA, 1994 for Construction of Jhatikara- Dwarka 400 KV D/C line (Twin HTLS) under Rajasthan REZ
phase-III, part-D, phase-II Scheme, New Delhi, under Delhi Preservation of Trees Act (DPTA), 1994 as sought
by the Tree Officer (West Forest Division).
2) This notification for exemption under Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994, in any case, shall not be considered as
permission for felling/transplantation of trees under the DPTA, 1994.
3) The application for felling/transplantation of tress shall be considered and scrutinized independently and
separately by the Tree Officer (West Forest Division) under the provisions of the DPTA, 1994, the Delhi
Preservation of Trees Rules, 1996, relevant guidelines, directions issued in this regard and all relevant court
orders with due application of mind minimizing the number of affected trees to be transplanted from within the
exempted area.

By Order and in the Name of the Lt. Governor
of National Capital Territory of Delhi,
VIJAY KUMAR BIDHURI, Secy.
